title: schedonorus arundinaceus subsp. orientalis
intro: Schedonorus arundinaceus subsp. orientalis, commonly known as Oriental meadow-grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Schedonorus arundinaceus subsp. orientalis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and act as a natural anti-coagulant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
